_about: What the stock client shows on its first entry to town each session: one popup per notice,
paged when there are several. Edit and save; the server reads the file again when it changes.
Fields: id, headline, body, image (a URL, or a path under this server's /content), layout
(portrait or landscape), action (MAP, SHOP, INVENTORY, TRAINING, GEMS, TAVERN, CLOSE: the
button's label and where it goes), link {name, url} (a second button, opens the browser),
from / until (ISO dates; the notice shows between them), networks (client network ids; omit
for all). The headline is drawn in capitals.

_example.headline: Ranked races are open
_example.body: Find MATCHMAKER on your friend list and press JOIN. Stand in the skull ring to race.
